summary: ZeroTier Alert Settings CRUD API fully tested. All 13 tests PASSED. The alert system allows users to enable alerts per ZeroTier client with configurable recipients. The scheduler runs every 60 seconds to check monitored clients (confirmed via backend logs).
critical_code_review_comments: Alert endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id field from responses
require_site_access() correctly checks network admin status and main_site_users collection
Scheduler loop uses proper async/await and catches exceptions to prevent task crashes
Frontend has data-testid attributes on alert buttons (zt-alert-on-{id}, zt-alert-off-{id})
seed_data_creation: Test alerts created during testing are cleaned up (disabled) after each test method
context_for_next_testing_agent: ZeroTier alert settings API is working correctly. The scheduler checks monitored clients every 60 seconds. ZeroTier API is NOT configured on preview (no token/network ID), so actual member status checking cannot be tested - only the CRUD API for alert settings was tested.

features_tested.PUT_disables_alert: PASS - Setting enabled=false disables the alert
